rows.en: ...\p-san.
(Sigh... I really did her wrong...)
(Nyan-Nyan's food is so good~)
Munch munch...
One maguro bun, sorry for the wait!
Munch... Thanksh... Nanashe...
rows.notes: Talking with a full mouth: 'arigato... Nanase' garbled.

rows.en: ...Geez, please don't talk with your mouth full!
Mm-hmm... Munch munch...
You sure can eat, though.

Your Galaxy Ramen's ready too!
It's hot, so be careful.
rows.notes: Galaxy Ramen as in earlier campus slices (menu item, not in glossary).

rows.en:
Sluuurp...
Ow, hot, hot!!!!
Oh, geez... I just warned you a second ago.
What are we going to do with you...
S-somebody!!
They ran off without paying!!
What?!
rows.notes: x7: also Nanase in ext_rnk_002, Shirakawa in frd_myk_007, the player in frd_rnk_005.

rows.en: A dine-and-dash?!
Oh no, we've gotta go after them!
rows.notes: Ranka; she and Nanase both give chase (c02336 'just the two of you').

rows.en: R-Ranka-san!

H-hey, wait!
It's dangerous, just the two of you...!
Huff... huff... huff...
Nanase, are you okay?
D-don't worry about me... Go help Ranka-san...
O-okay... Let's meet up later!
I'm counting on you...
Stop right theeere!

R-Ranka! It's dangerous!!
Leave the rest to me.
No way, this is about our shop!
Oh, come on, come on!
rows.notes: x4: also frd_luk_101 (player pushing food on Luca); ii kara ii kara.

rows.en:
Phew... I managed to catch them, but...
I didn't realize I'd come all the way out here...
Thank you very much.
rows.notes: x4: also the Pilot Students in nml_pnn_019.

rows.en: You really saved us!
I don't know how to thank you...
Y-you don't need to thank me.
I can't just leave it at that...

Well then, how about you put today's bill
on the house?
Is that really all you want?
Yeah. What do you say, Ranka?

Hmm, I think your bill was pretty big, but...
I guess that's fine?
Then it's settled. Let's head back together.
What do you mean, head back?

It's your treat, so I've gotta start eating
all over again!
Y-you're going to eat even more?!
I'm just getting started~
Haah, the manager might get mad about this~
(Time to eat and eat and eat!)

Ranka-chan! It's dangerous!!
Leave the rest to me.
Yeah. What do you say, Ranka-chan?
Heading home, Nanase?

...Yes.
Are you heading home by yourself?
Really, all by yourself?
Huh? Yeah... W-what about it...?
rows.notes: x14 across many 'heading home' scenes, both genders.

rows.en: I-I'd rather you didn't stare at me like that...

Sigh...
...I wanted you to be the one to tell me, though.
I see...
rows.notes: x12: also Ranka (ext_rnk_006/007) and Akimizu (ext_yuu_003/005), after the player says there's nothing to tell.

rows.en:
I hear you've gotten close to that girl lately...?
I heard the rumors.
rows.notes: Nanase (male version); also Akimizu in ext_yuu_003, both genders. onna no hito -> 'that girl'.

rows.en:
Come visit the art room sometime, okay?
I'll be waiting!
Heading home, Nanase?
Yep, I am.
Huh? Yeah, by myself... W-what about it...?
I-it's awkward when you stare at me like that...

Where's this coming from all of a sudden...?
Tell you what? Nothing in particular...
I think? Probably...
rows.notes: Answers Nanase's 'I wanted you to tell me yourself'.

rows.en:
I hear you've gotten close to that girl lately...?
I couldn't help hearing the rumors.
Huh? Rumors? What are you talking about?!

uncertain: c02345: 'ii kara ii kara' shared with frd_luk_101 (forcing food on Luca); 'Oh, come on, come on!' chosen to fit both.
c02372/c02379: 'ano onna no hito' rendered 'that girl' (schoolmate); c02372 is also Akimizu's line in ext_yuu_003.

c02378: 'iu koto tte... toku ni wa... nai wa yo? tabun...' rendered 'Tell you what? Nothing in particular... I think? Probably...'; the male counterpart c02181 (slice 30) is not translated yet, so not harmonised.
c02341: 'onegai shimasu' as Nanase asking the player to catch up with Ranka: 'I'm counting on you...'.
missing_glossary: Galaxy Ramen (ginga raamen, Nyan-Nyan menu item; follows earlier slices)
